metadata.case_name: LAM SHUI NGAN v. GLOBAL CHEER LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: resumed light duties with the 1st Defendant; briefly employed as a security guard

source: The Plaintiff complains that she is still suffering from persistent low back pain.
(a) "tenderness of the spinous process at L5 and Sl levels in the midline";
(c) "tenderness over the left iliac crest and left gluteal region";
(d) "decrease in straight leg-raising on the left lower limb";
(e) "decrease in sensation over the posterior left thigh, posterior left calf and sole, and milder degree of sensory impairment over the left aspect of left calf";
(f) "muscle wasting noted in the left calf".
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: tenderness of the spinous process at L5 and S1 levels in the midline
tenderness over the left iliac crest and left gluteal region
decrease in straight leg-raising on the left lower limb
decrease in sensation over the posterior left thigh, posterior left calf and sole
muscle wasting noted in the left calf

treatments_received: physiotherapy (18 months of treatment noted in physiotherapy report dated 22.2.2007)
admissions to Prince of Wales Hospital

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (PSLA) arising from persistent low back pain and related physical impairments
